basic_info.description: Stunning Stylish Home in Vibrant Excelsior. Welcome to 738 Athens Street, a stylishly renovated modern home in the heart of Excelsior, where sleek design meets everyday comfort. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3 full bathrooms, this thoughtfully updated residence offers a spacious, open floor plan ideal for today's lifestyle. The cozy living space flows seamlessly into a formal dining area and a contemporary kitchen equipped with a large eat-in island, abundant cabinetry, and professional-grade appliances, perfect for both casual meals and gourmet cooking.    Designed for entertaining, the home includes multiple indoor and outdoor gathering spaces, including a stunning glass staircase that leads to a bright lower level. There, you'll find a large family room, dedicated media room, a private guest suite, and access to the beautifully landscaped modern backyard garden, ideal for relaxing, hosting, or gardening. Located within walking distance to McLaren Park, public transportation, and neighborhood amenities, this home offers both tranquility and convenience in one of San Francisco's most vibrant communities. A true gem that blends form, function, and location!
